comment: Pinned shader toolchain for spec 008 (task T-023). An unpinned toolchain makes 'it compiled yesterday' meaningless, so every field here is recorded and verified before a compile run.

tint.source: google/dawn release builds (Tint ships as Dawn's bin/tint.exe)
tint.compilerVersionNote: this tint build has no --version flag (it rejects the flag and prints usage), so the pin is the release asset SHA-256 plus the Dawn commit in the asset name. A substituted binary therefore fails get-toolchain.ps1 before it can translate anything.
tint.archiveNote: the archive is ~118 MB; only <root>/bin/tint.exe is extracted
tint.validation: the generated WGSL is parsed and regenerated by the same binary; a parse or semantic error exits non-zero

spirv.reason: Tint/Dawn consume SPIR-V 1.4-era modules; vulkan1.1 is the environment DXC produced in the verified runs

gaps.why: cross-backend constant-offset comparison needs a SPIR-V disassembler; the DXIL side is checked by reflect.ps1 and the WGSL side is validated by Tint, but the SPIR-V constants themselves are not compared

the web target owns its Emscripten pin (AGENTS.md records 6.0.13 per host); this library compiles to DXIL/SPIR-V/WGSL and does not invoke emcc, so T-023's Emscripten half is not covered by this pin file
